title:
Tracking, review
and customising
say: Part three: tracking cells over time, reviewing and changing your answers, and making the app your own.

title: It jumps? Tap where it goes
say: This deck asks whether a tracker stays on the same cell. When it jumps to a neighbour, choose It jumps, go to the frame, and tap where the cell really is. The app also records which segmented cell you tapped.

title: Divisions: tap both daughters
say: When a cell divides, choose Divides, and tap both daughter cells. Each tap is saved with its position, frame and cell number.

title: Track a cell yourself
say: In a follow deck, you track a cell yourself. Tap the cell in each frame, and the app moves on by itself. Hold the image to see the previous frame. Not here skips a frame, and when the cell divides, tap Divides and both daughters.

title: Review and change answers
say: Review shows every card with your answer. Filter by answer, tap any card, and answer it again. The full history is kept, so nothing is lost.

title: Add a note
say: Tap note to keep a comment on any card. Notes go into the export with your answers.

title: Make the answers your own
say: Edit the answer buttons to rename them, add new ones, or choose what happens next, like drawing a mask or typing a number. And switch on confetti, for the answer you hope to see.

title: Colours, name and backup
say: In settings, set your name, choose colour blind safe colours, and back up everything. Restore the backup on any device, or share a Google Drive folder with your team, and compare everyone's answers in results.

title: deke1yahav.github.io/hooman
say: That's Hooman in the Loop. It's free and open source. The A.I. guesses. The hooman decides.
